artDirection.compositionGrammar: A portrait product comic read top to bottom: one claim, one causal action and one evidence state per panel group, with the lower CaptionLayer band reserved.
artDirection.lighting: Flat paper-white fields, decisive ink silhouettes and restrained blue or coral emphasis; no cinematic glow or decorative lighting claims.
artDirection.medium: Code-drawn editorial manga panels combining product process diagrams, file identities, waveform evidence and sparse personified production roles.
artDirection.motionLanguage: Frame-driven panel reveals, ink traces, state handoffs and readable settled holds; motion explains ownership or invalidation rather than decorating the screen.
artDirection.palette: Warm paper, near-black ink, coral action emphasis, blue evidence identity and muted sand secondary structure.
artDirection.texture: Sparse screentone, hand-ink edge variation and restrained speed lines generated locally; no remote textures or unlicensed media.
artDirection.typography: Large geometric system sans for product terms and compact Chinese labels; all Scene text stays visually distinct from the sole CaptionLayer authority.

continuityRules: Read panels from top to bottom and carry the blue evidence thread through all ten Scenes.
Use coral only for an action or invalidation event and blue only for a sealed or current identity.
Keep the Producer character at the left of authored inputs and the Checker character at the right of mechanical evidence.
Reserve y=1470 through y=1830 for CaptionLayer exclusion; no critical product label, checksum or action may enter it.
End each Scene on a stable panel state that the next Scene can inherit without moving spoken frame boundaries.
Show only repository-verifiable M1 through M8 workflow facts and the current M9 production itself.
forbiddenTreatments: No automatic layout, Scene DSL, automatic director, keyword-selected card or runtime directory scan.
No CSS animation, CSS transition, Tailwind animation utility or wall-clock motion.
No logo, website, Git remote, customer, metric, benchmark or M10 release claim.
No historical production Scene, old Composition, still or contact-sheet imitation.
No subtitle-shaped text inside Scene renderers and no panel boundary derived from punctuation.
No upstream preview, screenshot, bundled audio, font or sample media in runtime.
